title: Where does bromine land?
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Under these conditions HBr adds across propene with Markovnikov regiochemistry: bromine ends up on the middle carbon and hydrogen on the terminal carbon.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of propene under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Propene is treated with HBr without peroxides. Which major organic product forms after workup? Under these conditions HBr adds across propene with Markovnikov regiochemistry: bromine ends up on the middle carbon and hydrogen on the terminal carbon.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
